comments.author: mynameisvlad
comments.story: Microsoft's DroidRage Twitter campaign goes painfully wrong
comments.why: IE9 dubstep ad praised among newer Microsoft ads
comments.text: Their newest ads are pretty awesome. Surface's dancing ad [LINK] , the IE9 dubstep [VIDEO] , the IE10 troll [LINK] , and the various Windows 8 international musical ads (the wave after the countdown ad) [LINK] [LINK] and [LINK] are definitely a step way up from previous ad campaigns that Microsoft launched. All in all, the Windows 8 ads are IMO fresh, and definitely leaning more towards the younger adult hip side. And they're pulling it off pretty nicely.

comments.author: DeepDuh
comments.why: IE9 ad contrasted with inconsistent messaging
comments.text: Well, Microsoft's marketing was never really known for consistency, was it? Compare it to this IE9 ad for example: [VIDEO] . Imagine an average consumer seeing these ads and then he sees this: [LINK] . Which one do you think he will understand? To which can he relate more? (Btw. I don't say iCloud is good. Microsofts Skydrive on win8 (or whatever they're calling their cloud offerings now, I really don't have an overview anymore) seems quite compelling - but it seems to me like they can't really communicate well enough what it does.)
